description: This file contains utility functions and type imports related to provider authentication input handling, including API key normalization, validation, and prompting logic for environment variables and user input.

methods.name: normalizeApiKeyInput
methods.description: Normalizes raw API key input by trimming, removing quotes, and semicolons.

methods.name: validateApiKeyInput
methods.description: Validates that the normalized API key input is non-empty.

methods.name: formatApiKeyPreview
methods.description: Creates a truncated preview of the API key for display purposes.

methods.name: normalizeTokenProviderInput
methods.description: Normalizes token provider string to lowercase trimmed string or undefined.

methods.name: normalizeSecretInputModeInput
methods.description: Normalizes secret input mode string to 'plaintext' or 'ref' or undefined.

methods.name: maybeApplyApiKeyFromOption
methods.description: Attempts to apply API key from provided options if valid.

methods.name: ensureApiKeyFromOptionEnvOrPrompt
methods.description: Ensures API key is obtained from options, environment, or prompts the user.

methods.name: ensureApiKeyFromEnvOrPrompt
methods.description: Main function to get API key from environment variable or user prompt, with support for ref mode.
